_notes: 18709 'Exaltáte Regem sæculórum in opéribus vestris' — not a direct psalm verse; liturgical Advent versicle, likely echoing Tob 13 or an office compilation; translated by sense. 18719 line 1 'Constántes estóte… auxílium Dómini' — echoes 2 Chr 20:17 (思高: 你们无需战斗…你们必要亲眼看见上主为你们所施行的救援); rendered by sense for breviary versicle context. 18719 lines 3–4 'Veni Dómine / Deus a Líbano' — Advent O-antiphon / Hab 3:3–4 composite; 'a Libano' (from Lebanon) is the Vulgate but Hab 3:3 says 'from Teman' in Hebrew/思高 ('上主由提曼来'); kept the Vulgate place-name 黎巴嫩 to match the liturgical Latin source. 18727 'virgam hereditátis' — Vulgate Ps 73:2 'virgam hereditatis tuae' rendered via 思高 Ps 74:2 ('你所赎回而给你作产业的族团'); 'virgam' (rod/tribe/staff) rendered as '族团' (people/group of inheritance). 18731 'Et ánima mea, quam redemísti' — versicle response fragment (cf. Ps 24:20 Vulg / 思高 Ps 25:20, or Ps 118:154 Vulg); rendered by sense. 18735 Vulgate Ps 118:55 = 思高 Ps 119:55 (no offset needed; Ps 119 = Ps 119).
